question: How is the supreme piercing defined in relation to all states and classifications?
premises: The supreme piercing occurs when all states are exhausted.
It is distinguished within a framework of mantra, power, world, form, knowledge, body, place, and channel.
The tradition explicitly declares this as the supreme piercing.
inference: The highest piercing is a state beyond all limited states and beyond all classified levels.
uncertainties: The long compound at the end may be read as a source of distinction or as the set of categories being transcended; the ablative supports distinction.
plain_english: When all states have been exhausted, that is declared the supreme piercing, distinguished from the levels of mantra, power, world, form, knowledge, body, place, and channel.
